crossRefs.note: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory; but when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.
When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; but when the wicked rule, the people groan.
They turn the needy out of the way. The poor of the earth all hide themselves.
In every province, and in every city, wherever the king’s commandment and his decree came, the Jews had gladness, joy…
Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.
But the word of God grew and multiplied.

translations.web: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous thrive.
translations.bsb: When the wicked come to power, people hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous flourish.
translations.kjv: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: but when they perish, the righteous increase.
translations.asv: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; But when they perish, the righteous increase.
